blocks.text:
Welcome to Pantanal! At Campo Grande’s International Airport, a local driver will take you to your hotel in Pantanal. Pantanal is in the center of the South American Continent. This is a unique world conservation area located in Brazil. A wetland covered with dense flowering vegetation is the main landscape of the area. Here, lakes and rivers with crystal clear water shelter the rarest specimens of birds and animals. Travelers stay in modern hotel-houses (Lodges), which provide complete comfort and convenience. 

Upon arrival, the first impression is one of awe, as the sheer expanse of the Pantanal unfolds before the visitor. The sprawling marshes, lush grasslands, and winding waterways create a picturesque panorama that captivates the senses. The air is filled with the distinct sounds of exotic birds, rustling vegetation, and the occasional splash of aquatic life.

Pantanal is for nature lovers, scientists, fishermen, photographers, and people tired of the rhythms of modern urban life - this is the most suitable place. Here you will find peace, watching the life of birds and the huge size of butterflies, listening to the sounds of nature, dissolving in it. During your stay, the following tours will be scheduled at the pousada, horse riding, boat rides, trekking, piranha fishing, birdwatching, photo safari, and nocturnal viewing of the Caymans. 

After arrival at the Hotel to unpack, the first tour is a boat ride in the afternoon to enjoy the breeze and see the sunset.

Explore the Aquidauana River and all the beauty and exuberance of its riparian forest, with its centuries-old trees, serving as a natural habitat for birds, mammals, and reptiles seeking refuge along its banks or simply indulging in the sounds and songs of birds, part of a lifetime experience.

Overnight at Pousada Aguape.

blocks.text:
In the morning, after breakfast, it’s time for horse riding. 

Horse riding in the Pantanal is an immersive and enchanting experience that allows visitors to connect with the vast and diverse landscape of this unique wetland ecosystem. The rhythmic clip-clop of hooves on the earth sets the pace for the adventure, as the horse and rider navigate through narrow trails and open plains. The tall grasses sway in the gentle breeze, and the air is filled with the natural symphony of bird calls and the occasional rustle of wildlife.

The horseback ride provides an intimate connection with nature, allowing riders to appreciate the subtleties of the environment that might be missed in other forms of transportation. The calm demeanor of the horses and the expertise of local guides contribute to a sense of ease and tranquility during the journey. 

After the adventure, return to the hotel to have lunch and a little rest before embarking on another journey.

In the afternoon, the local guides will take you to a photographic Safari to see the wonders of Pantanal in a 4x4 Jeep.

The journey takes you through a variety of habitats, including marshes, grasslands, and waterways, each offering distinct photo opportunities. The golden light of the Pantanal's sunset provides an ideal backdrop for capturing the natural beauty of the surroundings. Photographers can witness the landscape coming to life as they capture the first light touching the water, creating reflections that add a magical quality to the images.

The wildlife photography opportunities in the Pantanal are truly exceptional. Capybaras, the world's largest rodents, may be seen lounging near water, while caimans bask in the sun along riverbanks. Birdwatchers can capture the elegant flight of herons, storks, and kingfishers, among countless other species. Majestic predators like jaguars and elusive giant otters might also be the focus of a lucky shot. Throughout the safari, guides share their insights into the behavior and ecology of the wildlife, enhancing the experience for photographers who seek not only stunning visuals but also a deeper understanding of the Pantanal's delicate ecosystem.

After this amazing excursion, you will go back to the hotel to have dinner.
